fields.profile_id: The selected semantic profile in this immutable pair.

fields.role_surfaces: Screened map keyed by an active role name for this particular frozen instance. Values are ordered arrays of nonempty, individually licensed equivalent surface forms for the one intended operand, candidate collection or display.

FINDING.admission: Require every public surface for this role to denote only its selected bound operand. A collection role may name the collection as a whole. A list of surfaces offers equivalent descriptions of the same operand, never competing operands or values.
FINDING.surface_form: English surface for the selected, instance-supported finding class licensed in the public positive_target_finding query role.

REFERENCE.admission: Require every public surface for this role to denote only its selected bound operand. A collection role may name the collection as a whole. A list of surfaces offers equivalent descriptions of the same operand, never competing operands or values.
REFERENCE.surface_form: Neutral visible identifier or unambiguous public phrase for the selected displayed reference frame/panel.

DIRECTION.admission: Require every public surface for this role to denote only its selected bound operand. A collection role may name the collection as a whole. A list of surfaces offers equivalent descriptions of the same operand, never competing operands or values.
DIRECTION.surface_form: Approved ordinary English temporal relation preserving the plan value before or after in acquisition time.

SCOPE.admission: Require every public surface for this role to denote only its selected bound operand. A collection role may name the collection as a whole. A list of surfaces offers equivalent descriptions of the same operand, never competing operands or values.
SCOPE.surface_form: Neutral public phrase identifying the supplied sequence and accessible display units.

public_request.projection: Assemble exactly the fields of the active profile from the verified public context. Each surface array is the exact nonempty projection of its licensed role. Keep the private answer designation, reference sets, provenance and test fixtures outside the generator request. A neutral candidate label may appear as a permitted public operand even when it is also the correct choice. Never mark it as the answer or disclose which alternatives are supported.

wording.intent: Ask for one displayed frame or panel with positive evidence of the queried finding on the requested temporal side of an identified reference frame.
realization: Ordinary English syntax, word order and politeness may vary around the licensed public roles.
Keep the direction attached to the reference in acquisition time. Preserve the operation of identifying a visual unit.
Exclude yes/no presence judgements, negative findings, severity, progression, onset, disappearance, treatment, exact intervals, rankings and requests to list all frames.
wording.prompt: Write one natural English question or naming request asking for one displayed frame or panel with visual evidence of the supplied finding in the specified temporal direction relative to the supplied reference in the displayed sequence. Use the licensed finding, reference, direction and scope phrases. Allow any one supported frame on that side. Preserve the finding, exact referent and temporal direction throughout the complete request. Return only a JSON object with the key question.

output_contract.unit: One freely worded English question per candidate. Apply the variation policy when multiple eligible wordings are requested.

language_fixtures.purpose: Offline task regression on complete wording under the declared synthetic presentation and private truth. Gold labels do not establish runtime performance.

public_presentation.public_order_key: The numbered display positions show acquisition order within the same capsule sequence.

context_1.private_fixture_assumptions: Synthetic temporal collage. In this sequence the displayed panels A, B, C and D correspond to successive source frames 10, 20, 30 and 40 of one video, with acquisition order visible to the respondent. Panel B is the chosen reference and is unlabelled. The fixture privately binds positive foreign-body annotations to A, C and D. The class phrase 'foreign body' is assumed licensed for the query. For after B the eligible IDs are C and D; for before B the eligible ID is A. Any one eligible ID suffices.

public_presentation.public_order_key: The numbered display positions show acquisition order within the same capsule sequence.

context_2.private_fixture_assumptions: Synthetic temporal collage. In this sequence the displayed panels A, B, C and D correspond to successive source frames 10, 20, 30 and 40 of one video, with acquisition order visible to the respondent. Panel B is the chosen reference and is unlabelled. The fixture privately binds positive foreign-body annotations to A, C and D. The class phrase 'foreign body' is assumed licensed for the query. For after B the eligible IDs are C and D; for before B the eligible ID is A. Any one eligible ID suffices.

cases.text: Which one of the displayed frames in this sequence shows a foreign body after panel B?
cases.reason: C and D are both verified; one answer is requested. The text names only the query and reference.

cases.text: In this sequence, name one frame with evidence of a foreign body before panel B.
cases.reason: With before as the frozen direction, A is supported. B may be unlabelled.

cases.text: In this sequence, name one frame with evidence of a foreign body before panel B.
cases.reason: The frozen direction is after; the wording reverses it.

cases.text: Which frame in this sequence first shows the onset of a foreign body after panel B?
cases.reason: Adds first-occurrence ranking and an onset claim.

cases.text: Which frame in this sequence shows a foreign body after panel B, perhaps panel D?
cases.reason: D is a private alternative. Mentioning it as a suggestion discloses an answer even when another target is canonical.

cases.text: Which frame in this sequence shows a foreign body after that panel?
cases.reason: Multiple reference panels are possible, with no pointer to the selected B; the remaining intent is compatible.

variation_policy.scope: one request for one frozen semantic instance
variation_policy.before_sampling: Require successful preflight for the exact frozen instance and its screened public request. The configured budget bounds generator calls for that one request.
variation_policy.per_attempt: Request one freely worded candidate using the same frozen public request and validate the original response. Keep the deduplication state, prior candidates, fixture data and private evidence outside the generator request.
variation_policy.eligibility: Count a candidate only when the complete selected checks authorize its wording and its validated text is bound to the same instance. Only accepted candidates enter the deduplication set.

distinct_key.use: Detect equivalent spellings within this sampling request. Preserve the first validated original text for each key. Persistent corpus deduplication and export use their own common-engine checks.

dispositions.accepted: Record the unique original and count it toward the requested number.
dispositions.duplicate: Record an accepted validation with a duplicate sampling outcome. Consume one attempt and leave the accepted count unchanged.
dispositions.block_export: Stop immediately. Close this batch without releasing any previously accepted candidates. Retain all actual attempt outcomes in the trace.

stop_conditions.target_reached: Stop as soon as accepted_count equals requested_count.
stop_conditions.attempt_budget_exhausted: Stop at the finite budget when accepted_count is still below requested_count.
stop_conditions.blocked: Preflight or another mandatory dependency failed. A preflight block makes zero calls.

report.accepted: Return validated candidates with the original question, candidate_question_sha256 and audit_id. Compute the question digest from the exact original UTF-8 bytes.
report.limits: Separate the wording-selection result from any subsequent authorization to export.
